text:
jamal: Heads-up I'm cutting RC rc/2026-03-23-1 from main now. Preparing for promo window 2026-03-24 00:00-03:00 UTC. Need QA signoff by EOD PDT today. Can ops confirm staffed coverage?

deploy-bot: build finished: rc/2026-03-23-1 -> artifact: inference-api:sha:beefcafe. CI: https://ci.example.com/builds/5777777000. Smoke + e2e triggered.

liz: Picking up QA. Will run smoke -> long-tail token tests -> eval set. Will report quick pass/fail.

ops-bot: infra: pinned inference-api=sha:beefcafe on staging namespace. Canary route prepared. KV prefill scheduled job id=66012.

jamal: Note: this RC includes a change to the batching allocator and a smaller quantization tweak; please pay attention to latency distribution and quality for short prompts.

liz: Staging smoke pass at 5777777120. Quick perf: p95 down ~12% on short prompts, p99 unchanged. Found one failing regression for chat-formatting on a legacy prompt (low severity). Logging ticket ENG-1182.

qa-bot: regression report attached: https://ci.example.com/reports/5777777120/regressions.html. Severity: minor formatting. No generation truncation observed.

nina: Ops: I can be oncall for the promo window. Proposed promo plan: 1% canary for 20m -> 10% for 20m -> 50% for 30m -> 100%. Abort conditions: any sustained 5xx >1% for 10m OR token-error regression (quality delta > 0.02) on our eval set. Rollback plan: traffic flip to tagged previous prod sha:deadbeef and re-pin routing.

ops-bot: rollback commands (ops snippets):
```
# immediate pin back to previous artifact
kubectl set image deploy/inference-api inference-api=inference-api:sha:deadbeef -n prod
# or flip rollout flag
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" https://flags.example.com/api/toggles/inference-api/rollout -d '{"state":"previous"}'
```

jamal: Requesting promotion: @deploy-bot promote rc/2026-03-23-1 -> prod with nina's policy above. Keep kv-prefill active during ramp and enable detailed sampling for the first 10k requests. Tag #incidents if any alerts.

deploy-bot: promotion job queued id=66013. Starting 1% canary now. Warm ETA ~4m.

nina: I enabled canary dashboards and a temporary eval hook that samples 1 in 50 requests for quality checks. PagerDuty rule set to notify me at first sign of threshold breach.

ops-bot: Promotion reached 1% at 00:02 UTC. Artifact sha:beefcafe pinned to prod-route canary.

liz: Observability check at +10m: errors flat, latency improved for short sequences, sampled outputs look good. No formatting regressions seen in sampled 2k requests.

jamal: Proceed to 10% at +20m if green. @deploy-bot please schedule next step.

deploy-bot: stepping to 10% now. Background KV fill continuing.

liz: 10% hold check: p95 stable, token-error delta 0.005 (below threshold). QA PASS.

nina: Advancing to 50% now. Keeping an eye on slowlog. If we see slowlog increase by 20% over baseline, we'll stop and evaluate.

ops-bot: 50% reached. Traffic distribution updated.

jamal: Draft release notes (short):
- Reduced latency for short sequences via improved batching allocator
- Tweaked int8 quantization for smaller memory footprint
- Fixed minor formatting regression in exporter (post-landing ticket ENG-1182)
I'll publish full notes after final promotion.

liz: Final QA readout: green across functional and perf checks. Recommend full rollout after 30m at 50% hold.

nina: I'll wait 30m and then proceed to 100% if all green. Oncall ready.

deploy-bot: 30m since 50% hold reached; proceeding to 100% now. Promotion job id=66013 complete at 00:58 UTC.

ops-bot: Prod pin completed: inference-api:sha:beefcafe is now the main prod artifact. Old sha:deadbeef retained for fast rollback.

jamal: Thanks team. I'll open the release-notes PR and tag product. Leaving this thread open for the quiet window — report any anomalies here and @nina for immediate ops responses.
